QuestInfo.name: Swamp Monsters, Sprouted
QuestInfo.0: The Dark Lord has one more job for you. It looks like he's ready to tell you the truth about the Muddy Swamp Monsters.
QuestInfo.1: The true form of the Muddy Swamp Monsters has been witnessed, and you are to learn all about these new beasts. Eliminate #b150 #o2230115#s#k and return with #b50 #t4000673#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated #o2230115#s and brought the #t4000673#s to the Dark Lord.

0.0: The monsters in the Swamp Region are acting up lately. Strange sprouts are popping up out of the Muddy Swamp Monsters, and I need one of my own to check it out. You're the one I'm sending.
0.1: It's worst in the #m103030400#. Go there and eliminate #b150 #o2230115#s#k, and bring me #b50 #t4000673#s#k.\r\n\r\n#e(Accept to go to #m103030400#.)#n

no.0: You dare turn me down? Fool!

yes.0: Yes, good. But how is this...? Give me a moment.

mob.0: Don't forget to eliminate the #o2230115#s while you collect the #t4000673#s.
